functions.name: hc_resolve
functions.stdout: none (sets globals; HC_MODE is task or session)

functions.name: hc_hash_stdin
functions.stdout: hex digest of stdin, or empty when no hasher is available

functions.name: hc_pkg_probe
functions.notes: Lockfile-driven Node package-manager probe shared by done-detect.sh and worktree-detect.sh. HC_PKG_MGR is EMPTY for a non-Node project; HC_LOCKFILE is the literal 'none' when no lockfile is present (a bare package.json still yields HC_PKG_MGR=npm, so manager and lockfile are reported separately). HC_YARN_BERRY is 1 only when .yarnrc.yml sits beside yarn.lock.

functions.name: hc_verification_state
functions.notes: Freshness ONLY: is the done-state's verification still describing HEAD? 'carry' means the shas differ but the TREES are identical (tree equality, deliberately not ancestry). Fails toward 'stale' on a missing state, missing jq, an empty head_tree, or any mismatch. Shared by done-gate.sh Step 5 and finish-worktree.sh so the two can never diverge; says nothing about green outcomes, review-log presence or coverage, which callers must still enforce.

functions.name: hc_is_harness_own_path
functions.return_codes: 0 = the path is harness-owned (state dir or its config); 1 = not owned, including on an empty path

functions.name: hc_filter_harness_own
functions.stdout: the stdin porcelain lines whose path is NOT harness-owned (blank lines dropped)

functions.name: hc_changeset_summary
functions.stdout: multi-line changeset summary (stat + session-authorship + tree breakdown)

functions.name: hc_cfg
functions.stdout: effective value of the given flat config key (session-config.json, then done-config.json, then the caller's default); arrays space-joined

functions.name: hc_path_is_noncode
functions.return_codes: 0 the path matches a noncode_globs pattern, 1 code (or empty path); optional 2nd arg is the pre-read glob list

functions.name: hc_review_blocking
functions.stdout: integer count of blocking findings, or ERR

functions.name: hc_review_coverage_gap
functions.stdout: newline-separated uncovered files, empty=full coverage, or SKIP
functions.notes: extra_admit (5th, optional) is a carried review-anchor sha admitted to the chain by name and resolved at <head>; callers must pass it only after proving the anchor's tree equals HEAD's tree. chain_admit (6th, optional) is an ORPHANED review-anchor sha admitted by name but resolved at ITS OWN sha, so its attestations are blob-checked against <head> instead of self-validating; it needs no tree-equality proof, and an unresolvable sha contributes nothing (fail toward block).

functions.name: hc_validate
functions.notes: Fail-closed: rejects any schema containing an unsupported keyword (outside the enforced subset + benign-annotation allowlist), naming the offending keyword.
